introduction.value:

·
Nov 20, 2026

method.value: One commenter used Grok Bot as an orchestration layer for a local budgeting app: Claude Code did the coding, Codex checked reports and issues, and Grok Bot read those outputs, planned and scheduled build rounds, then suggested the next step. The person reviewed build-plan debates between ChatGPT and MetaAI, sent the chosen plan to Dr Eggbot to make a project-specific bot, and then checked Grok Bot’s messages on their phone after Claude Code’s build script sent an iMessage.

outcome.value: They said it worked fine and “great,” but slowly because of usage limits. Letting Grok Bot do all the coding in week one burned through weekly limits in hours and could eat another $100 per week, so they moved coding to Claude Code and did about 15 rounds a day.

notes.value: The main catch was cost and limits: cheapest tiers were enough to test, but heavy Grok Bot use exhausted weekly allowance fast and slowed the workflow.

source_text.body:
Have Grok Bot read reports and suggest next steps
A commenter checks messages from Grok Bot after it reads reports and suggests the next step; another let it do all the coding but hit weekly limits quickly.
·
Nov 20, 2026
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
One commenter used Grok Bot as an orchestration layer for a local budgeting app: Claude Code did the coding, Codex checked reports and issues, and Grok Bot read those outputs, planned and scheduled build rounds, then suggested the next step. The person reviewed build-plan debates between ChatGPT and MetaAI, sent the chosen plan to Dr Eggbot to make a project-specific bot, and then checked Grok Bot’s messages on their phone after Claude Code’s build script sent an iMessage.
How it went
They said it worked fine and “great,” but slowly because of usage limits. Letting Grok Bot do all the coding in week one burned through weekly limits in hours and could eat another $100 per week, so they moved coding to Claude Code and did about 15 rounds a day.
Worth knowing
The main catch was cost and limits: cheapest tiers were enough to test, but heavy Grok Bot use exhausted weekly allowance fast and slowed the workflow.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Every [morning/week], read the reports I put in [folder or inbox location] and send me a short message with the key points and the one next step you recommend. If a report needs a decision from me, say so clearly at the top. Don't send anything to other people or change any files without showing me first.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GrokBot/comments/1y0m9fj/anyone_using_grok_bot_alongside_another_agent
